title: tradeskillframe
summary: MSUI's current TradeSkillFrame is a law-positioned 384x512 player profession panel with the stock rank StatusBar, exact eight-row faux-scroll controls, created-item (ItemClass, ItemSubClass) groups named verbose-first from ItemSubClass.dbc, tier/item-level/name sorting, fold headers and Collapse All, subclass and byte-law inventory-slot filters, product/list/reagent tooltips, have/need reagents and tool/focus gates, plus typed bounded repeat count, Create All, Create and Exit/Cancel batch behavior.

openItems.text: Flat recipe list: no collapsible subclass group headers (+/- fold rows), no Collapse All button
openItems.resolution: ProfessionFrameUiLaw.BuildTradeSkillTree groups created products by (ItemClass, ItemSubClass), sorts group entries by difficulty tier/product item level/name, emits +/- header rows, and applies persistent per-group and Collapse All state.

openItems.text: No filter dropdowns (subclass filter, inventory-slot filter)
openItems.resolution: The two law-positioned TradeSkill dropdown controls select an ItemSubClass group or the exact byte-confirmed InventoryType-derived slot bit; empty groups disappear under filtering.

openItems.text: Skill rank shows as text 'value / max' with no status-bar fill (ref TradeSkillRankFrame is a StatusBar)
openItems.resolution: DrawProfessionRankBar paints the exact shared 268x15 blue skill StatusBar and stock border with line name plus value/max text.

openItems.text: List scrolls by mouse wheel only - no scrollbar widget on the recipe list (the trainer window has one; this one does not)
openItems.resolution: DrawProfessionScrollBar provides the 16px cropped stock up/down buttons and draggable knob for the law-bounded eight-row faux list, alongside wheel scrolling.

openItems.text: No item tooltips on the product icon or reagent rows
openItems.resolution: TradeSkill recipe rows, selected product icon, and each reagent row now publish ItemTemplate snapshots through the existing shared GameTooltip owner arbitration.

openItems.text: No creation-count spinner (ref's number input with +/- and the typed count next to Create)
openItems.resolution: The TradeSkill-only three-digit vanilla input with decrement/increment buttons clamps to current material availability and latches that count into the existing one-cast-at-a-time batch machine.
